title: stelis scansor
intro: Stelis scansor, commonly known as the "Ironwood" or "Ironwood Tree", is a flowering plant species in the orchid family (Orchidaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional folk medicine, where it has been used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Stelis scansor include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of sedation, antispasmodic effects, and antioxidant properties.
